scope: Independent review of Aurora Light and Aurora Dark static UI concept boards, each with landscape and portrait, plus accurate decision/input notes

requirements.check: Inspect both actual theme boards and all four landscape/portrait views; no prompt-only approval.
Both themes retain the recognizable selected Aurora r2 floating-panel family and simple visual hierarchy.

No visible fixed or floating movement joystick, movement disc/ring, directional movement arrows, fake finger/hand or touch overlay remains in any view. Map heading and expansion arrows remain allowed and required where applicable.
Dark theme changes UI chrome without turning the camp into a nighttime or heavily darkened world; both themes show the same recognizable daylight scene.
Wood 640, stone 240, food 128 and fuel 36 are identical and legible across both themes and orientations.
Key status, objective, Camp, Build, minimap and unambiguous map-expansion affordance remain visible and legible.
UI has safe-looking margins, no visible cutoff or colliding controls, and broad natural gameplay space where the joystick was removed.
The original stylized winter-camp identity, two open gate passages and centered furnace remain recognizable in all four views.
Light and dark themes are coherent, modern, comfortable and easy to scan; dark labels/icons have clear visual contrast over the daylight game.

Decision/input notes accurately record the confirmed Aurora selection and no-joystick/touch-anywhere request; new light/dark artwork is not described as owner-approved, and a drag-input scheme is labeled an authored interpretation rather than already-built behavior.

scoring.pass_requires: Every mandatory scoped check passes and every mandatory reviewed dimension is strictly above 9.0

next_action: Wait for actual image paths and decision/input notes, inspect all views, report exact defects and repairs, then review corrected outputs if needed.
